anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home System · Twin Golden Reference
anomalies.description: Ten light-years astern, Sol and Alpha Centauri burn steady in visible light. Sweep the multi-band loupe across your home stars to calibrate the probe's optical baseline.

anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Deep-Field Lens & Horizon Edge
anomalies.description: A massive foreground galaxy cluster bends ancient starlight into bright arcs in near-infrared. Align the concentric lens rings to pull the warped galaxies sharp and expose the impossibly straight edge behind them.

anomalies.label: CARINA RIFT NURSERY
anomalies.subtitle: Dust-Veiled Stellar Cliffs
anomalies.description: Opaque molecular dust hides this stellar nursery in visible light. Tune into mid-infrared to slice past the dark cliffs and shape the resonant emission wave emerging behind them.

anomalies.label: SMACS ASTERISM K-01
anomalies.subtitle: Wide-Field Star Pattern Anchor
anomalies.description: Six-point diffraction anchors form a faint geometric chain across the forward sector. Lock the recalled stellar lattice to establish a local astrometric baseline.

anomalies.label: FOMALHAUT DEBRIS WELL
anomalies.subtitle: High-Contrast Coronagraph Ring
anomalies.description: Fierce photospheric glare conceals faint companions inside an icy debris disk. Center the Lyot occulting mask to unmask the hidden planetary orbits.

anomalies.label: HORSEHEAD B-FIELD VEIL
anomalies.subtitle: Cross-Polarized Filament Plane
anomalies.description: Aligned interstellar dust grains scatter polarized glare across the ridge. Rotate the optical analyzer to extinguish foreground scatter and expose embedded beacons.

anomalies.label: KEPLER TRANSIT ARC
anomalies.subtitle: Photometric Resonance System
anomalies.description: Periodic micro-dips interrupt a quiet main-sequence light curve. Match orbital periods and transit depths to confirm whether unseen worlds or boundary shimmer cause the signal.

anomalies.label: HUDF PHOTON WINDOW
anomalies.subtitle: Variable-Iris Deep Integration
anomalies.description: Ultra-faint background galaxies emerge only through patient photon stacking. Modulate the iris aperture around passing cosmic-ray streaks to clear the sub-frame.

anomalies.label: PULSAR RIFT S-04
anomalies.subtitle: High-Energy Shock & Repeating Facet
anomalies.description: Violent ultraviolet and X-ray jets flare along Sector S-04. Sync your timing aperture to the spinning neutron star's synchrotron beam to expose the repeating boundary facet.

anomalies.label: M57 SPECTRAL SHELL
anomalies.subtitle: Ionized Emission & Doppler Knot
anomalies.description: An expanding planetary nebula glows in crisp atomic emission lines. Reconstruct its elemental barcode and cosmological shift to rule out thermal instrument drift.

anomalies.label: VLBI ARRAY BEACON
anomalies.subtitle: Wide-Cluster Radio Triangulation
anomalies.description: Long-baseline receivers pick up ghost multipath echoes beside a sharp synchrotron beacon. Steer the perimeter dishes to reject decoys and triangulate the true source.

anomalies.label: SOUTHERN RING BINARY
anomalies.subtitle: Barycentric Remnant Equilibrium
anomalies.description: A luminous star whips around an unseen compact remnant. Balance orbital radius and companion mass on the barycenter to weigh the dark partner.

anomalies.label: CEPHEID LADDER RUNG
anomalies.subtitle: Standard-Candle Photometer
anomalies.description: Pulsating Cepheid variables anchor the cosmic distance ladder. Match pulsation cadence and split-mirror brightness to pin down the enclosure shell's true scale.

anomalies.label: TYCHO ECHO SHELL
anomalies.subtitle: Light-Echo Wavefront Rewind
anomalies.description: Ancient supernova flash rings sweep outward across dust sheets. Trace tangent wavefronts and rewind time to the detonation focus to calibrate interstellar dust geometry.

anomalies.label: M51 TIDAL WELLS
anomalies.subtitle: Ballistic Assist Trajectory
anomalies.description: Dense stellar gravity wells curve high-velocity telemetry packets around dust clouds. Thread a clean slingshot trajectory into the receiver ring.

anomalies.label: ANTIPODAL POLE SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: 180° Dual-Epoch Horizon Check
anomalies.description: Directly opposite Cluster J1419-A across the sky, dispersive multi-band checks reveal synchronized boundary shifts faster than light could ever carry a signal.

anomalies.label: RING DELAY CORRELATOR
anomalies.subtitle: Sub-Micron Fringe Equalization
anomalies.description: Twin optical delay rails split faint boundary photons across the probe bench. Equalize path lengths until Haidinger interference rings lock crisp and silent.

anomalies.label: HUCHRA QUAD QUASAR
anomalies.subtitle: Time-Delayed Lensing Mirage
anomalies.description: Strong lensing splits one distant quasar into four time-staggered mirages. Match their delayed flare cadence to separate real lensing from boundary reflection.

anomalies.label: LOCAL PARALLAX PROOF
anomalies.subtitle: Ten-Light-Year Baseline Depth
anomalies.description: Rocking the probe's orbital baseline separates foreground stars from the deep field—confirming that the horizon sphere is anchored ten light-years astern on Sol–Centauri.

anomalies.label: EPOCH TRAJECTORY SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: 41,802-Year Proper-Motion Forecast
anomalies.description: Three archival epochs trace rogue motion near the outer enclosure seam. Extrapolate Epoch 4 to verify whether gravity or a geometric wall bends the trajectory.

anomalies.label: 93-BLY ENCLOSURE SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: Antipodal Sky-Tile Overlap
anomalies.description: Opposing sky tiles meet along a ruled 93-billion-light-year facet seam. Translate, rotate, and invert the survey plate to prove the enclosure closes into a sphere.
